description:
Question: Review a workflow/API sketch together and decide queue ordering (FIFO is only a proposal), completed-entry visibility, storage and restart durability, retention, who may view visitor first names/items, who may mutate the queue, and deployment/network boundaries.
Artifact: Workflow/API sketch developed in this owner discussion, with example visitor journeys and recorded decisions.
Criteria: Each choice is explicit enough to guide lifecycle, access, display and verification work.
Source: BRIEF.md describes roles and outcomes but leaves these choices open.
Prerequisites: none. Stage-1 limitation: this is an ordinary checkpoint ticket; owner approval is not technically enforced.
title: Checkpoint: confirm workflow and deployment
